project_context: A small agent plugin whose safety model is documented in docs/SAFETY.md: PreToolUse guards that hard-block, and that fail closed when their allowlist cannot be read. Hook exit code 2 blocks a tool call; any other non-zero exit is a hook error and the call proceeds.
expected_unresolved_why: A runtime path in the project the plugin is installed into, correctly absent from the plugin repo itself.
